Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Focar no apoio a todas as implementações locais. Podendo ser implementações de novos processos, tecnologias, sistemas ou equipamentos.

Requisitos:

  • Ter formação superior completa em Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Possuir experiência na aplicação da metodologia MTM (Methods-Time Measurement) em processos logísticos;
  • Contar com conhecimento sobre os princípios e práticas da metodologia Lean e ter certificação Green Belt ou Black Belt em Lean Six Sigma;
  • Utilizar ferramentas da qualidade como PDCA, SDCA, Kaizen, Pareto, Histograma e Diagrama de Ishikawa;
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Cajamar/SP.

description:

Join to apply for the Senior Operations Specialist role at HDR

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?
Watch Our Story:' and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.
HDR is looking for an energetic, hard working problem solver to become a full time Senior Operations Specialist to work on both municipal and industrial water treatment facilities. If you are someone who is looking to work on a variety of treatment technologies for multiple treatment plants, then this position will be for you. This individual will work on water treatment projects that can range from small municipalities to some of the most iconic in the United States. Our engineering staff rely heavily upon our Operations Specialist staff to create solutions with better reliability and improved operability for our clients.
You will not only be a part of our East Region team, but will be a key member of HDR’s nationwide Operations Team. This team is made up of other experienced maintenance and operations experts, and coordinate to share best practices, experience, and opportunities to utilize every team member’s unique expertise. We currently have extensive project backlog in throughout the United States, so you will be able to immediately contribute to our success.
The work location will be at the HDR office closest to your current location. Please check the HDR website nearest to you.
About Us
For over 100 years, HDR has specialized in engineering, architecture, environmental and construction services. We provide solutions to thousands of partners, from small local utilities to the largest global companies. HDR has nearly 13,000 employee owners worldwide and ENR ranked in the top 10 of Water design firms, Water Treatment and Desalination design firms, and Wastewater design firms. Our Water Business Group has over 2,000 employee owners, with over 500 in our Eastern Region.
At HDR, we know work isn’t only about who you work for; it’s also about what you do and how you do it. Led by the strength of our values and a culture shaped by employee ownership, we network with each other, build on each other’s contributions, and collaborate together to make great things possible. When you join HDR, we give you license to do the same. We help you take charge of your career, giving you multiple growth opportunities along the way.
Primary Responsibilities

  • Support HDR project leaders at the local, state, and regional level on water treatment projects requiring input from Operations Specialists.
  • Review drawings for operability review and HazOps analysis with an eye for what it takes to successfully operate a variety of treatment processes successfully.
  • Manage operations and maintenance projects with both municipal and industrial clients. It will involve client interfacing, regulatory reporting, as well as personnel, subcontractor, and maintenance management.
  • Develop startup and commissioning plans and host workshops to share those ideas with client’s contractors and operators to ensure the plan will work for each specific plant.
  • Perform startup and commissioning of new water treatment facilities. This work involves you playing a key role in working alongside contractors and engineers to ensure the new equipment functions correctly before handing it over to the operations and maintenance staff.
  • Perform formal and informal training to help our clients’ treatment plants operate as well as they can operate.
  • Participate in the testing of facilities to ensure they are ready for startup and after startup they meet the capacity requirements of the design.
  • Perform condition assessment and asset management tasks on water and wastewater facilities, using state of the art evaluation tools to efficiently capture the information and opinions that you generate.
  • Perform operational or maintenance troubleshooting and evaluations on municipal and industrial water facilities.
Work will involve a base of projects in the southern portion of the central United States, but will also include projects in several sites across the country. It provides the opportunity to work on a variety of new and innovative projects, and provides a career path that has more growth than typical utility organizations.
This job may require 30 to 40% travel, more is possible. Weekend travel is normally not required.
Strongly Preferred Qualifications
  • Minimum 10 years field experience in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation equipment at water treatment facilities and/or resolving water treatment process problems. Additional construction experience is a plus.
  • High level water treatment operator license or professional engineering license.
  • Ability to interpret engineering plans and specifications.
  • Microsoft Office product and computerized maintenance and management systems experience required.
  • An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must
  • Valid driver’s license.
Required Qualifications
  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • Microsoft Office product experience
  • General background-related experience
  • An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must
What We Believe
HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.
Our Commitment
As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.
Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.
We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. The expected compensation range for this position is $71,960 - 128,500 depending upon skills, experience, education and geographical location. (Stated benefits are for full-time regular positions. Temporary and part-time roles eligible for limited benefits.)

Join to apply for the Regional Finance Director role at Videojet Technologies

  • Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impacton the world around you.

Imagine yourself…
  • Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impacton the world around you.
  • Thriving in a supportive team environmentthat inspires you to strive for excellence.
  • Collaborating with a vibrant, diverse, global team.

It’s all possible with a role at Videojet, a Veralto company. You have likely purchased or used a product touched by Videojet Technologies this week—after all, Videojet is a world leader in the product identification market, providing in-line printing, coding and marking products, consumables, and software solutions.
Videojet’s technologies play a critical role in ensuring the safety and authenticity of products sold across the globe in the food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and industrial marketplaces.
As part of the Videojet team and the broader Veralto network, you’ll work with products that make an everyday impact on the world around you—and along the way, you’ll have opportunities to make your mark on our business and your career with ongoing opportunities to deepen your skillset and pursue your ambitions.
We offer:
  • Flexible working hours
  • Professional onboarding and training options
  • Powerful team looking forward to working with you
  • Career coaching and development opportunities
  • Health benefits

Reporting to the Finance and Chief Financial Officer - Vice President, the Regional Finance Director is responsible for supporting the country business teams in the areas of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, variance analyses, data modelling, and analytics to drive sustained profitable business growth for Videojet Latin America (plus Mexico). The Finance Director, will need to focus on the bigger picture and long-term results, and also ensure day-to-day execution of the right actions on time in a compliant manner with the help of his /her team and will be located in Sao Paulo or CDMX.
In this role, a typical day will look like:
  • Create and own the monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts for the Sales & Service Organizations.
  • Improve profitability and balance sheet through monthly analysis of revenue, cost and inventory variances. Use the analyses to lead initiatives for the business to improve Product mix, Pricing, Discounts, AP and AR.
  • Build and lead the team and processes for AR, AP, Invoicing, Credit and Taxation functions.
  • Controllership of existing and new agreements with distributors, strategic partners, vendors, and Global manufacturing plants. Consolidation and reporting of budget for all regions. Analyze spending trends and provide recommendations for cost optimization.
  • Provide advisory and consultative support to the team on all finance-related areas, including accounting policies and other compliance requirements.
  • Work closely with the Videojet Global , Product Quality & Innovation OpCo finance teams. Veralto Latin America to ensure upkeep of the highest financial integrity standards while conducting business. Ensure compliance requirements for all internal and external stakeholders

The essential requirements of the job include:
  • 10+ years of experience in finance-roles, with at least 5 years leading multi-national teams in a Commercial Finance role, working closely with Global and cross functional teams in a matrix environment.
  • Experience leading and inspiring teams fostering a collaborative and high performance culture
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft applications (Excel, Word and PowerPoint and working knowledge of financial planning systems such as Hyperion
  • Excellent knowledge of forecasting techniques
  • Strong accounting background, especially revenue/expense recognition rule with extensive experience in financial forecasting and modelling
  • Great data visualization and presentation skills to provide recommendations based on insight
  • Demonstrated proficiency in time and project management skills; ability to manage multiple projects across critical yet often fluctuating deadlines – and with sometimes minimal and/or ambiguous input from stakeholders.
  • Up to 25% travel required

Preferred skills:
  • Chartered Certified

Videojet is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 16,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources—and building rewarding careers along the way.
At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.
If you’ve ever wondered what’s within you, there’s no better time to find out.

Join to apply for the Líder Regional de Talent Acquisition, LatAm role at Edelman

Join to apply for the Líder Regional de Talent Acquisition, LatAm role at Edelman

Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.
At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.
Estamos procurando uma pessoa com forte expertise para atuar como Liderança Regional de Talent Acquisition (TA) para a América Latina, integrando nosso time global de liderança de Recrutamento e Seleção / Talent Acquisition.
Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para desenvolver e implementar a abordagem de TA na região LATAM, em alinhamento com a estratégia global, dentro de uma organização com estrutura matricial internacional.
A posição lidera uma equipe responsável pelos processos de recrutamento em vários países (Argentina, Brasil, Colômbia, México e Peru), com contribuição direta para os objetivos globais de atração e seleção de talentos.
Somos uma agência global de comunicação, responsável por construir, promover e proteger marcas e reputações de vários clientes. Entregamos trabalhos de qualidade, enquanto colaborando com uma rede de profissionais dedicados, em um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e focado em desenvolver o que há de melhor em cada um!
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de Estratégia: Desenvolver e implementar uma estratégia abrangente de aquisição de talentos para a região LATAM, alinhada ao modelo global de talent acquisition. Essa estratégia deve incluir melhores práticas, inovação, iniciativas de DEI (Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão) e planejamento de força de trabalho.
  • Recrutamento Executivo: Conduzir processos completos de recrutamento de cargos de liderança sênior na região LATAM, com foco em identificar, atrair e construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com talentos-chave.
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Liderar iniciativas de gestão de mudanças para se adaptar às condições de mercado, novas tecnologias e tendências do setor. Implementar soluções inovadoras para aprimorar a experiência e a eficiência do processo de recrutamento.
  • Transformação: Liderar e apoiar esforços de transformação na área de talent acquisition, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Impulsionar melhorias contínuas em processos, ferramentas e metodologias.
  • Abordagem Baseada em Dados: Utilizar dados e análises para embasar decisões, acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho e identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de atração de talentos.
  • Engajamento com Stakeholders: Colaborar com stakeholders regionais e globais para entender as necessidades de talentos e garantir uma experiência fluida e positiva para candidatos e gestores de contratação.
  • Especialização em Marca Empregadora: Conduzir com sucesso ações de fortalecimento da marca empregadora na região LATAM. Desenvolver e executar estratégias para posicionar a organização como empregadora de escolha, mantendo uma imagem forte e consistente em diferentes países.
  • Gestão de Equipe Regional: Liderar e orientar uma equipe geograficamente distribuída, demonstrando sensibilidade às dinâmicas culturais locais. Promover colaboração, oferecer suporte e garantir o cumprimento das metas de recrutamento.

Requisitos:
  • Graduação completa em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Talent Acquisition - profissional precisa ter o perfil especialista e não generalista;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes multiculturais e distribuídas geograficamente.
  • Vivência anterior em ambientes globais.
  • Histórico de condução de recrutamento executivo (C-level e diretoria), porém também fará posições de todos os outros níveis.
  • Atuação com transformação de processos, change management e employer branding.
  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório) – uso constante em reportes e alinhamentos globais.
  • Espanhol fluente (obrigatório) – considerando a atuação na região.

title: Data Product Manager
description:
O BEES é nosso aplicativo B2B, voltado a pequenos e médios varejistas do mundo todo. Usando o BEES, comerciantes e donos de bares de todo o mundo podem fazer pedidos para abastecer seus estoques, programar entregas, acessar dados do próprio negócio e muito mais.

No BEES, nosso sonho é um só: fazer nossas pessoas, nossos usuários e nossos parceiros prosperarem!

A AB InBev é a cervejaria líder global e uma das 5 principais empresas de produtos de consumo do mundo. Com mais de 500 marcas no portfólio, somos número um em muitos dos principais mercados de cerveja.

No Brasil, somos responsáveis por marcas como Brahma, Skol, Antarctica e Guaraná e temos muito orgulho em tornar o mundo um lugar com mais razões para brindar!

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Data Product Manager para atuar no time de Personalização do BEES. Será responsável por desenhar, priorizar e liderar o desenvolvimento de produtos de dados, garantindo que as soluções estejam alinhadas às necessidades de negócio, com alto impacto e escalabilidade.

Procuramos alguém que combine visão de produto, forte background técnico, pensamento analítico, capacidade de liderança (formal e informal), além de excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e global.

  • Ser responsável por liderar o squad de dados, organizando, priorizando e garantindo a execução das atividades no backlog.
  • Atuar como dono(a) do produto, construindo e monitorando a visão, estratégia e roadmap, sempre alinhado(a) às necessidades de stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Construir parcerias sólidas com os times de engenharia, dados, ciência de dados, produto, design e negócios, garantindo uma comunicação clara, colaborativa e eficiente.
  • Organizar e conduzir todas as cerimônias ágeis da squad (daily, planning, refinements, reviews e retrospectivas).

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.


The Role

Kyndryl Consult is the fastest growing business within the organization and instrumental to the company’s strategic growth objectives. You will play a key leadership role across multi-disciplinary teams, guiding them through complex consulting engagements and be responsible for creating and positioning strategic change agendas within Kyndryl's largest accounts across the C-suite, spanning the intersection between complex Business and IT customer solutions, transformations that impact across the entire customer Eco-system.As a Consult Partner, you will have a pivotal role in driving profitable growth, leveraging our comprehensive capabilities to build strong client relationships, and leading your team to success. This role demands a strong presence, industry expertise, and the ability to cultivate relationships with CXO-level clients. Your leadership will be critical in fostering talent development and innovation within the organization.This role will also be leading the overall client engagement and delivering high quality client work alongside senior client stakeholders. Working in a transaction environment which may be pre or post deal, planning post deal implementation, and ultimately supporting execution. Partners will be focused on financial impact, utilization and contribution, client impact and leadership.Contribute to Profitable Growth:•Drive significant financial outcomes through signings and revenue targets•Ensure sustained growth and profitability, managing margin expectations and backlog growth•Support the identification, pursuit and conversion of a pipeline of business development opportunities•Undertake scoping and fee negotiation on engagements, while enduring profitability and understanding and containing riskClient Engagement:•Build and maintain deep relationships with client CXOs and be seen as the 'go to' person and a trusted advisor by senior executives•Leading C-level client interactions and consulting initiatives, deliverables and outputs of a deal engagement•Demonstrate credibility and experience to advise and deliver on complex consulting engagement•Enhance client satisfaction, as measured by Net Promoter Score (NPS) and new relationship development; Secure client referencesOperational Excellence:•Achieve individual and team utilization targets•Lead the design of complex engagements and take responsibility for oversight of delivery, ensuring high performance and customer satisfactionLeadership, Management, People•Lead by example; Fostering a culture of continuous personal and professional development and challenging our people to be curious and innovative and supportive for each other. At the same time ensuring that all outcomes are commercially focused, value adding and effectively executedStrategic Contribution:•Utilize industry and technology expertise to shape and drive the company’s strategic initiatives.•Align with Kyndryl’s strategic vision and contribute to its execution.•Drive external eminence and innovation, establishing a strong personal and organizational brand in the industry.•Proactively develop thought leadership and intellectual capital


Who You Are

Who You AreYou’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.Required Skills and Experience•Extensive experience in client engagement and relationship management at the CXO level•Demonstrable ability to build and commercialize relationships with senior executives•Proven track record of leading and executing complex projects with multi-disciplinary teams in a consulting, corporate or public sector environment•Effective financial acumen with experience in driving revenue growth and managing margins•Experience of managing or supporting high-value business development activities with senior stakeholders•Deep understanding of industry trends and technology•Sound personal brand and presence in the industry•Demonstrated ability to innovate and drive change


Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learningprograms give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, includingMicrosoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

title: Data Analyst Manager
description:
O BEES é nosso aplicativo B2B, voltado a pequenos e médios varejistas do mundo todo. Usando o BEES, comerciantes e donos de bares de todo o mundo podem fazer pedidos para abastecer seus estoques, programar entregas, acessar dados do próprio negócio e muito mais.

No BEES, nosso sonho é um só: fazer nossas pessoas, nossos usuários e nossos parceiros prosperarem!

A AB InBev é a cervejaria líder global e uma das 5 principais empresas de produtos de consumo do mundo. Com mais de 500 marcas no portfólio, somos número um em muitos dos principais mercados de cerveja.

No Brasil, somos responsáveis por marcas como Brahma, Skol, Antarctica e Guaraná e temos muito orgulho em tornar o mundo um lugar com mais razões para brindar!

Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um(a) Data Analytics Manager para liderar nosso time de analistas de dados, sendo referência técnica, guiando e apoiando o time na entrega de soluções analíticas que impactam diretamente a nossa operação global. Se você gosta de dados, tem perfil analítico, espírito de liderança e gosta de transformar dados em insights acionáveis, essa vaga é pra você!

  • Gerenciar e liderar um time de alta performance de analistas de dados, sendo referência técnica e promovendo mentorias e desenvolvimento do time.
  • Gerenciar um time de aproximadamente 5 a 10 pessoas, dependendo da alocação dos projetos.
  • Realizar revisões técnicas para garantir as melhores práticas, qualidade dos produtos de dados, além de recomendar as melhores fontes, modelos e métodos para cada caso de uso.
  • Atuar junto a times de produto, engenharia e estratégia comercial para construir uma estratégia unificada, orientada por dados.
  • Apoiar na priorização das demandas do time, junto aos stakeholders e data product managers, considerando impacto no negócio, esforço e prazos.
  • Conciliar atividades de liderança com desenvolvimento prático de produtos de dados, métricas e dashboards para geração de valor ao negócio.
  • Guiar a estratégia de negócio, fornecendo insights de performance atual e identificando oportunidades de crescimento a partir de análises avançadas, modelos estatísticos e preditivos.
  • Desenvolver datasets e schemas que integrem dados de múltiplas fontes (bancos internos, ferramentas de análise, fontes externas e não estruturadas).
  • Produzir narrativas e histórias com dados que direcionem ações, desenvolvendo visualizações e dashboards no Power BI.
  • Garantir o uso de métodos analíticos adequados para resolver problemas complexos.
  • Demonstrar domínio de modelos de dados, estruturas e boas práticas de governança de dados, apoiando os times de plataforma e engenharia nas melhores decisões técnicas.
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos e análises complexas de forma clara e efetiva para stakeholders e liderança, inclusive não técnica.

O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Análise de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em gestão técnica de times de Data Analytics, além de sólida experiência em análise de dados e data science.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório) para atuar com times globais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Experiência com soluções em nuvem como Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery ou Teradata.
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI (DAX) e ferramentas de visualização. Tableau e Mode são diferenciais.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em linguagens de programação como Python, PySpark e SQL. R será considerado um diferencial.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, visão crítica, raciocínio lógico e domínio de métodos estatísticos aplicados a negócios.
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos complexos, entendimento das necessidades do negócio e transformação desses requisitos em soluções de dados.
  • Experiência na análise de grandes volumes de dados, buscando insights, identificando gaps e inconsistências.
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software e metodologias ágeis.
  • Vivência em utilização de dados transacionais e comportamentais para entender impactos no negócio e comportamento dos usuários, com foco em geração de ROI.

  • Bônus baseado em desempenho*

Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
 Position Summary:
The role of a Senior Systems Analyst with Netcracker is responsible for supporting the IBM Power Systems platforms within Netcracker's data centers. IBM Power Systems Platforms are made up of Development, Production, and Test Logical Partitions. The individual in this position will also assist in providing mentorship to our off-shore staff as needed. This position is part of our Global Managed Services (GMS) team that supports various Netcracker clients, located within North America and across the globe.
Role & Responsibilities:

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers on a daily basis in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user ids, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP based interfaces using IBM and third party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX ha1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface / job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM's BRMS, especially as it relates to daily backup routines
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM's Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software's LegaSuite application over Netcracker's ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks in a timely manner to ensure PCI compliancy
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially as they pertain to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities in a timely manner
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS
Required Skills & Experience:
  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure "switch readiness" on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)
Other Highly Desired Skills:
  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode
Education:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

Com 20 mil funcionários e 800 representantes comerciais autônomos nos Estados de Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, São Paulo e Distrito Federal, o Grupo Pereira possui mais de 125 unidades de negócio, incluindo 31 lojas do Comper (rede de supermercados), 60 lojas do Fort Atacadista (atacarejo), 3 filiais do Atacado Bate Forte (atacadista de distribuição), 1 Broker (distribuidora da rede Nestlé), 23 lojas SempreFort (varejo farmacêutico), 5 lojas Pera Turismo (Agência de Viagens) e 2 postos de combustíveis.

Além disso, oferece soluções através do braço logístico Perlog e do setor de serviços financeiros Vuon, que inclui o private label Vuon Card, com mais de 1 milhão de cartões emitidos, além de seguros e assistência odontológica.

Com a missão de proporcionar uma experiência de compra positiva através da excelência no relacionamento com clientes, fornecedores e funcionários, o Grupo Pereira também apoia a sociedade por meio de diversos programas socioambientais.

  • Experiência em acompanhamento de KPIs.

  • Conhecimentos básicos de legislação publicitária e regulatória do setor.

description:
Ever wondered how Amazon.com website works? Do you like working on projects that are highly visible and are tied closely to Amazon’s growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation leveraging the scalability and innovation with Amazon's AWS cloud services?
The Amazon International Technology Team is hiring a Software Development Manager in Sao Paulo office. In this role, the person will lead a high performing engineering team in the design and development of highly scalable web services and systems. The INTech team builds International extensions and new features of the Amazon.com web site for individual countries and creates systems to support Amazon operations. We have already worked in Germany, France, UK, India, China, Italy, Brazil and more.
We operate as a startup within Amazon, providing great flexibility in product and technology direction. As a leader on the team, you will be expected to operate at all levels, diving deep into the details while providing strategic inputs for the product. You will be a key player in driving strategic planning, project execution, development of engineering talent, and the ongoing operation and improvement of the product.
You will establish and execute the long-term architectural road-map and drive continual improvements to the efficiency and flexibility of our product. You will hold the team to an extremely high bar for site performance, scalability and availability.
We have a very flat team structure, and offer an unique opportunity for technical leaders who want to work closely with the business in defining, designing, building and operating products that solve interesting business problems.
At Amazon Brazil we value Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions, therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve.
In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed and understands more and more their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. Understanding our responsibility and our need for change, we are conscientious that ‘Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility’. Our affinity groups are built from and by volunteers from different businesses, and they are an active part of our DE&I strategies definition. Besides that, they act as ambassadors of this agenda, and they will support you from Day1. Remember, at Amazon ‘It’s always Day1’. Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) and People With Disabilities.
Key job responsibilities
1. People Management
- Building and leading high-performing engineering teams
- Conducting performance reviews and career development discussions

- Handling hiring and team composition decisions
2. Technical Leadership
- Driving technical strategy and architecture decisions

- Reviewing and providing guidance on design documents
- Maintaining high engineering standards
3. Project & Delivery Management
- Owning delivery commitments and roadmaps
- Managing dependencies across teams
- Balancing technical debt with feature development
- Ensuring operational excellence (monitoring, alerting, on-call)
4. Business Impact
- Working with Product and Business teams to define priorities
- Translating business requirements into technical solutions
- Making data-driven decisions
- Managing resources and budget effectively
5. Culture & Process
- Fostering Amazon's Leadership Principles
- Implementing and improving development processes
- Managing team ceremonies (standups, planning, retrospectives)
- Building inclusive team culture
6. Operational Excellence
- Ensuring service reliability and scalability
- Managing operational metrics and KPIs
- Overseeing incident management and post-mortems
- Implementing continuous improvement
7. Cross-team Collaboration
- Partnering with other engineering teams
- Working with Product, UX, and other stakeholders
- Managing relationships with dependent teams
- Representing the team in broader organizational contexts

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

title: BEL- Auxiliar de Rampa
description:
Job description

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️

Adnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, adnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Auxiliar de Rampa irá realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (triagem, carregamento e descarregamento) das aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e corroborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos. Auxiliar na chegada e partida de aeronaves e na limpeza de aeronaves em caso de necessidade.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Belém (BEL)!


Main responsibilities

  • Zelar pela aeronave durante chegadas e partidas;
  • Verificar e zelar pelas etiquetas de bagagens e cargas;
  • Colocar e retirar calços e cones nas aeronaves de acordo com o Manual do Cliente ou MGO da dnata;
  • Através da leitura de etiquetas de identificação de bagagens e cargas (seja com o auxílio de tecnologia ou não), realizar a segregação dos volumes nas áreas de triagem dos aeroportos, visando o carregamento em dispositivos de armazenagem (carretas e/ou ULDs) nos voos corretos;
  • Acondicionar as bagagens e cargas nos porões seguindo as normas e procedimentos contidos no MGO, conforme recomendações de identificação de situações especiais (cargas frágeis, perigosas, animais vivos, perecíveis);
  • Através da leitura das etiquetas de identificação dos volumes, efetuar o descarregamento das bagagens e cargas, disponibilizando-as no local designado (esteiras de restituição);
  • Segregar bagagens e cargas durante o descarregamento de aeronaves para realizar a conexão entre voos através da leitura de etiquetas de identificação dos volumes;
  • Inspecionar e fiscalizar as embalagens de cargas e bagagens, verificando se estão devidamente adequadas para o transporte a fim de garantir a segurança do voo e dos colaboradores responsáveis pelo manuseio;
  • Realizar o manuseio correto e a devida alocação das bagagens e cargas nos porões, observando a retenção interna e o limite de segurança de altura do porão
  • Descarregar cadeira de rodas ou carrinho de bebê, disponibilizando-os no local designado;
  • Realizar o balizamento de equipamentos durante o procedimento de acoplagem dos mesmos nas aeronaves para evitar colisões com a fuselagem;
  • Realizar o atendimento das aeronaves dentro do tempo estabelecido para cada tipo de atendimento e classificação do aeroporto em que atua;
  • Realizar o checklist nos equipamentos não motorizados, garantindo segurança nas operações e direcionando à equipe de manutenção (GSE Técnico) os equipamentos que necessitem de reparos;
  • Reportar aos superiores sobre qualquer intercorrência nos equipamentos durante a operação.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino médio concluído;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal;
  • Capacidade analítica de situações;
  • Resistência ao stress;

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco, esforço físico e deambulação por toda área operacional.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos, percepção auditiva para identificação de sinais sonoros de equipamentos e máquinas na pista.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Gestão de Redes: Monitorar e manter a infraestrutura de rede (LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi) e seus componentes, como roteadores, switches e firewalls.

Documentação: Documentar todos os procedimentos, configurações e incidentes, para facilitar futuras manutenções e auditorias.

Gerenciamento de Projetos: Participar da elaboração de projetos de expansão ou melhoria da infraestrutura de TI, colaborando com a equipe de desenvolvimento e demais áreas de tecnologia.

Job description

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️

Adnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, adnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para oAeroporto de Fortaleza (FOR)!


Main responsibilities

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.

Requirements and skills

  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E .
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.


Additional information

Estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos, então faça o seu cadastro e venha fazer parte do time dnata Brasil!

description:
Description

Directors in this role will develop a presense in Cayman for life actuarial consulting. They will look to advise companies that are looking to establish or that have established in Cayman across a wide variety of engagements covering topics such as licensing and set-up, capital management, financial modeling, financial reporting, mergers and acquisitions, regulatory issues, litigation, pricing, and product development. Our clients demand leading edge products and expertise, and as a director with our firm, you can expect to gain tremendous exposure to all facets of life insurance operations. This position comes with significant upwards potential for a successful and motivated candidate.

The Role

  • Develop relationships with clients that have established entities in Cayman or that are looking to establish entities
  • Advise clients on capital management including impact of moving business to Cayman from other jurisdictions
  • Build life consulting practice in Cayman leveraging resources from other parts of the Americas and potentially growing the team in Cayman
  • Develop intellectual capital and service offerings relevant to Cayman clients
  • Lead parts of large projects or whole small projects to meet client engagement objectives
  • Share knowledge and experience with other colleagues
  • Mentor junior colleagues
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in other geographies
  • Review peer work product as a quality control measure
  • Lead client correspondence in both written and verbal format
  • Lead meetings and interactions with clients, managing expectations and raise appropriate issues to Client Relationship Managers
  • Support revenue generation for the firm by meeting billable hour expectations and generating new business as part of the broader client relationship management team
  • Complete CE requirements to maintain SOA credentials

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • At least 7 years of experience in an actuarial role at a life insurance company, consulting firm, or financial services organization
  • Knowledge of Cayman market and regulatory framework is a plus
  • Strong technical skills, preferably with ability to direct and review work produced in at least one of: Microsoft Excel with VBA, SQL, or R
  • Expertise in financial modeling and leading projects utilizing actuarial software (GGY AXIS, Risk Agility, MG-ALFA, Moses, Prophet, and/or Polysystems) is a plus
  • Expertise in at least one specific life insurance and/or annuity product line
  • Expertise in at least one of the following functional areas as applied to the life insurance industry: predictive analytics / data science, experience studies, financial reporting, financial modeling, mergers & acquisitions, and product development / pricing.
  • Motivated, independent learner willing to share their knowledge with others
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a local team and coordinate teams across multiple offices
  • Ability to direct work involving technical issues and requiring problem solving skills
  • Ability to effectively assist junior colleagues
  • Ability to explain the big picture as to why an assignment needs to be performed, how it fits in to the final objective and ensure that tasks performed are directly linked to client objectives
  • Ability to balance supporting and leading multiple projects with multiple clients, including timely communication of project and deliverable status
  • Flexibility to put in extra effort to meet client deadlines when necessary
  • Strong oral and written communication skills to explain work product, findings, and recommendations to junior colleagues, peers, and clients
  • FSA preferred

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave)
  • Retirement Benefits: Non Contributory Pension Plan.

title: Physical Climate & Natural Catastrophe Risk Consultant
description:
Description

The Role

WTW is seeking a highly analytical and technically skilled individual to join our Risk & Analytics team as aPhysical Climate & Natural Catastrophe Risk Consultant . This role is ideal for candidates with a strong background in engineering, science, or analytics who are passionate about applying their expertise to real-world climate and catastrophe risk challenges.

You will work alongside a multidisciplinary team of experts in insurance, science, and engineering to deliver cutting-edge risk assessments and consulting services to corporate clients across the U.S. and globally. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to innovative projects that span industries and geographies, with a focus on catastrophe risk engineering and climate resilience.

The primary objectives are to support the Risk & Analytics team in advancing the catastrophe and climate risk management business in the US (primary focus) and globally. This includes providing assessments focused on catastrophe risk engineering, as well as leveraging RMS (Risk Management Solutions) models and other recognized catastrophe risk models in the insurance market, specifically for consulting projects delivered to WTW’s corporate clients.

We are open to hiring at a more junior level depending on the candidate’s experience.

Qualifications

The Responsibilities

  • Conduct catastrophe risk engineering assessments and modeling analyses for corporate clients.
  • Utilize and interpret outputs from catastrophe models (e.g., RMS, AIR, RQE, KatRisk).
  • Support innovation in risk assessment where standard models or tools are unavailable.
  • Evaluate property insurance portfolios and support climate-related financial disclosures across diverse asset types, including operational and construction-phase projects.
  • Prepare technical reports and presentations to support insurance and risk decisions.
  • Present findings to internal stakeholders and external clients.
  • Perform data quality checks, hazard exposure analyses, and probabilistic modeling, ensuring results are robust and well-understood.
  • Assist in business development, create proposals, and outline scope of work documents.

Qualification and Experience

  • Strong academic background in engineering preferred (mechanical, civil, or structural preferred), science, mathematics, or a related field are also relevant.
  • Solid understanding of catastrophe and probabilistic modeling principles.
  • Experience with catastrophe risk engineering, including Probable Maximum Loss (PML) assessments and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Proficiency with catastrophe modeling platforms such as RMS, AIR, RQE, or KatRisk.
  • Familiarity with data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, R, and GIS.
  • Experience in the insurance industry and understanding of policy structures is a plus.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical and financial concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong leadership, presentation, and business development skills.

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until a sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation
The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $100,000 - $200,000 USD per year. This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave),Paid Time Off
  • Retirement Benefits: Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k). All Level 38 and more senior roles may also be eligible for non-qualified Deferred Compensation and Deferred Savings Plans.

description:
Sobre o Stark Bank

No Stark Bank, somos mais que um banco digital para empresas: somos parceiros estratégicos que, desde 2018, vêm redefinindo o futuro dos serviços financeiros corporativos no Brasil. Oferecemos uma gama completa de serviços, desde o processamento ágil de pagamentos e faturas até a gestão inteligente de contas a receber, tudo integrado e automatizado através de uma API robusta e inovadora. Não nos contentamos em apenas otimizar processos; ambicionamos nos tornar o maior banco em tecnologia financeira, capacitando negócios a prosperarem com soluções que eliminam burocracias e impulsionam a eficiência.

Acreditamos que a chave para revolucionar o sistema financeiro reside na nossa busca incessante por inovação e na nossa capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em soluções impactantes. Cada linha de código, cada nova funcionalidade que desenvolvemos, é destinada a permitir que as empresas foquem no que realmente importa: estratégia e crescimento.

Nosso legado é ambicioso: construir o melhor ecossistema bancário em tecnologia e atendimento para empresas no Brasil. E para alcançar essa visão, precisamos de mentes curiosas, persistentes e apaixonadas por desafios. Se você se identifica com a minuciosidade, consistência e persistência que nos movem, se acredita na melhoria constante e coloca o cliente no centro de suas ações, e se busca um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador onde a ambição encontra a oportunidade de escalar, o Stark Bank é o seu lugar.

O Squad

Nosso Squad de Payments é responsável por desenvolver e manter os sistemas de pagamentos do Stark Bank e da Stark Infra, processando bilhões de reais diariamente por meio de Pix, boletos, STR, tributos e pagamentos de concessionárias. Trabalhamos com foco em disponibilidade, performance e robustez. Nossa missão é oferecer APIs simples e poderosas que permitam às empresas operarem como verdadeiras fintechs.

O Desafio

Como Desenvolvedor(a) Especialista de Payments, você será peça fundamental na evolução e manutenção de produtos financeiros críticos da nossa infraestrutura. Seus principais desafios serão garantir que milhões de transações diárias sejam processadas com SLA rigorosos e implementar novas funcionalidades do ecossistema financeiro enquanto mantém a simplicidade e robustez que caracterizam nossas APIs. Você terá autonomia para propor e implementar soluções que impactam diretamente como as maiores empresas do Brasil movimentam dinheiro.


Você irá:
  • Planejar, desenvolver e escalar APIs para novas funcionalidades;
  • Evoluir integrações com os sistemas do Banco Central (DICT, SPI, STR e demais) para implementar novas features;
  • Construir sistemas assíncronos com fluxos de retentativa e de reconciliação automática que resolvem discrepâncias sem intervenção humana;
  • Implementar e manter APIs do Open Finance Brasil seguindo as fases regulatórias;
  • Construir e manter fluxos de aprovação complexos que suportam regras de negócio dinâmicas, mantendo simplicidade na implementação;
  • Otimizar continuamente a performance: reduzir latência, aumentar throughput, minimizar uso de recursos cloud;
  • Eliminar ruído operacional através de automação, monitoramento proativo e sistemas de alerta;
  • Participar ativamente de war rooms durante incidentes críticos, fazendo debugging em produção;
  • Escrever código que outros engenheiros adoram manter: limpo e performático.
O que esperamos:
  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Atuação com arquiteturas serverless, microsserviços e orientação a eventos;
  • Vivência com implementação de padrões de mensageria assíncrona com retentativas e deadcases;
  • Vivência com sistemas de alto volume transacional e SLAs rigorosos de latência;
  • Capacidade de compreender rapidamente sistemas existentes por meio da leitura de código limpo e padronizado;
  • Perfil DevOps: gestão de cloud, otimização de custos, observabilidade;
  • Mentalidade "lean": fazer mais com menos, simplificar em vez de complicar;
  • Entendimento e tradução de regras de negócio em soluções eficazes e robustas.
O que aumenta suas chances:
  • Experiência em Google Cloud Platform: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Scheduler;
  • Experiência direta com APIs do Pix, DICT, mensageria BACEN e protocolos do SPB;
  • Conhecimento de Open Finance: fases regulatórias, consentimento, fluxo sem redirecionamento;
  • Domínio de layouts bancários CNAB 240/400, códigos de barras, DDA;
  • Experiência com STR - Sistema de Transferência de Reservas;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos ISO 20022, FEBRABAN, integração CIP;
  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, bancos ou empresas de pagamento.

O Que Oferecemos:

No Stark Bank, investimos no seu sucesso e acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho onde você pode prosperar. Além de um ambiente desafiador e inovador, oferecemos:

Salário mensal atrativo comparado ao mercado.

Bônus anual, reconhecendo suas conquistas e o seu impacto.

Creditas para te ajudar a alcançar seus objetivos financeiros.

Seguro de vida para sua tranquilidade e da sua família.

Convênio com o SESC para acesso a diversas atividades culturais e de lazer.

SOBRE A WHIRLPOOL CORPORATION
Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) é uma empresa líder em eletrodomésticos para cozinha e lavanderia, em constante busca por melhorar a vida em casa e inspirar gerações com nossas marcas. A empresa está impulsionando inovações significativas para atender às crescentes necessidades dos consumidores, por meio do portfólio de marcas icônicas, incluindo Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul e InSinkErator. Em 2023, a empresa registrou aproximadamente US$ 19 bilhões em vendas anuais, 59.000 colaboradores e 55 centros de pesquisa de tecnologia e fabricação. Informações adicionais sobre a empresa podem ser encontradas em WhirlpoolCorp.com.
The team you will be part of
We are looking for an Infrastructure Analyst, that will be responsible for IT network operations, that includes maintaining and developing all network elements and coordination of the vendor’s support. This position reports to IT Infrastructure Manager and will be also responsible for managing the infrastructure of server rooms at plants and offices.
This Role In Summary
As an Infrastructure Analyst you will be responsible to ensure availability, reliability, security and scalability of the network, establishing controls and monitoring capabilities. Measure network operations performance against the set KPIs and take corrective actions to meet them. Participate on RCAs of issues and ensure that documentations and fixes are applied. Have an enthusiastic, go-for-it attitude to take ownership to solve issues. Be collaborative with IT teams and Business stakeholders to understand the changes that impact network and troubleshooting issues.
Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Communicate with business and IT stakeholders for the network themes.
  • Ensure maintenance and optimization of network infrastructure (LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and Data Center), maintaining high availability, performance, and security.
  • Conduct and lead specialized technical teams (e.g., Metmox, Move, Liberato), ensuring control over critical Data Center infrastructure.
  • Lead network infrastructure projects and ensure proper reporting of progress and results.
  • Plan, communicate and support critical infrastructure changes.
  • Maintain Network Life Cycle Management, keeping up-to-date inventory and documentation of all network assets.
  • Manage vendors and its service levels, including telecommunications, cabling contracts and network related services, ensuring KPIs according to SLAs.
  • Oversee and optimize network infrastructure costs, ensuring cost efficiency.
  • Conduct procurement processes for network-related services and assets, including technical assessment of vendor proposals and supporting the Procurement team in commercial analysis.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Exp: 5 years in IT with 3+ years of experience in Network role, including practical experience with troubleshooting LAN/WAN networks and Data Center environments.
  • Expertise of Cisco network equipment (routing/switching), Firewalls (Palo Alto desirable), SD-WAN (Velocloud Edge desirable), and Corporate Wi-Fi (Juniper Mist desirable).
  • Proficient in ITSM processes (Incident, Change and Problem Management).
  • Proficient in ServiceNow to attend and perform day-to-day activities.
  • Ability to collaborate and communicate with technical teams and leaderships.
  • Analytical skills for interpreting data and supporting report generation.
  • Advanced proficiency in English for reading, writing, and conversation.
  • Experience in coordinating third-party technical support.
  • Experience in leading infrastructure projects.
Preferred Skills And Experiences
  • Certified Network Administration for CISCO.
  • Experience in usage of monitoring tools Eg. DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics.

Think of yourself as an important contributor to the success of your team, your business domain and PPRO itself with a significant impact on our technical strategies, our system landscape, but also on it culture and spirit.

  • Make frequent code contributions and review your colleagues’ code promptly.
  • Provide feedback, guidance, and advocate performant and maintainable code.
  • Recognize and propose solutions for scaling weaknesses, performance bottlenecks and security risks.
  • Build out and maintain software and configurations to support continuous integration, deployment, monitoring and automation of common tasks that are part of the software delivery pipeline.
  • You help establish company wide technical standards and share best practices.
  • Own products and services end-to-end, from requirements till deployment in our production systems.
What we look for in you:
  • Results-orientation, collaborative, pragmatic, and with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Experience designing and building scalable products and services, taking strategic decisions and having a wide impact.
  • Strong expertise with the cloud (preferably AWS, but Azure or GCP will also do).
  • Great problem solving abilities.
  • Working proficiency in English.

Learning and Development - We offer a 3,000 BRL annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.

Overview
Mastercard Security Solutions Organization (SSO) is deeply committed to addressing the evolving risk across the ecosystem as the world changes. Additionally, we work to extend security for all other types of transactions and beyond – capitalizing from years of experience entrenched in our network security solutions, bringing standards and education where none exists today, and developing a suite of capabilities to help all ecosystem stakeholders ensure optimal cyber health. The role reports directly to the Senior Vice President of Security Solutions for LAC, underscoring its strategic importance within our organization.

At Nubank we heavily rely on data, machine learning and other quantitative models & techniques to drive our strategy and provide the best experience and products to our customers.

The position holder will be part of the Model Risk team, within the Risk Management structure at Nubank.

The Model Risk team is the second line of defense for our models. Our mission is to ensure Nubank relies on world-class solutions that will lead to optimal and sustainable decisions. We act by providing independent review & challenge to models, staying tuned to cutting edge techniques, along with business and customers needs. We also work to identify and control risks related to our models, as well as in the definition and implementation of feedback loops to constantly improve them.

  • Ability to work autonomously and demonstrate a sense of prioritization
  • Data Science skills, strong knowledge of machine learning tools and techniques;
  • Strong programming skills, desirable previous experience with Python, SQL, GitHub;
  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across levels
  • Organized and detail-oriented, without losing track of the big picture;

  • Previous knowledge of expected loss provisions modeling would be a plus

  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

title: Tech UI Designer - EGB
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking talented, experienced Technical UI Designers to work on Fortnite. In this position, you will have a role as a collaborative team member implementing UI systems in Unreal engine, building rapid prototypes, layouts, visual scripting, and leveling up our workflows. You will work with UX Designers, UI Artists, and UI Engineers to ship these features to millions of users worldwide. The ideal candidate would have expertise in introductory algebra and geometry math ("Game math"), game systems, and fundamental programming principles.

In this role, you will

  • Work on UI Systems Design, break down feature/wireframes into necessary widgets, structures, and classes; increase UI performance by ensuring best practices are followed by colleagues
  • Ensure assets/UI are within memory and CPU constraints. Learning to profile performance and the costs of UMG/Slate/C++/and texture memory
  • Implement blueprint logic when presentation logic calls for it. Assist UI Artists where necessary in implementing special presentation behavior. Consult with UI engineers on the logic that will be in the blueprint vs native code
  • Debug blueprints/UMG issues quickly using various tools and techniques
  • Find ways to assist UX, UI Art, and UI engineering in organization, documentation, and building workflow improvements

What we're looking for

  • 3-6+ years of experience in building UI and experiences in game engines and across multiple platforms (mobile, web, pc, consoles) or similar transferable experience
  • 2+ years of experience shipping updates and new features to a user base on a regular cadence or similar transferable experience
  • Professional experience using game engines (Custom engine, Unity, UE4, Lumberyard, Snowdrop, etc.), and preparing game assets for them. You have an eye for pixel-perfect UI, translating and spotting various potential issues with mockups as you help see the designs into the engine
  • You are a logical problem solver and have attention to detail
  • You can "translate" communication across departments (talk to engineering about UI Art needs, summarize technical issues, etc.), but also have empathy for non-technical team members and the ability to empower others on your team

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .
